item.title: Minting Next.js, Authentication Cookies
item.description:
Date: January 14, 2026
Tags: ["Web Security", "Next.js", "Authentication", "Vulnerabilities", "Cybersecurity Best Practices"]
Summary:
  • Next.
  • js apps using next-auth can have their authentication cookies minted by adversaries.
  • React2Shell vulnerability enables arbitrary code execution with little trace.
  • The NEXTAUTH_SECRET is critical and must be rotated regularly.
  • Attackers can impersonate any user if they obtain this secret.
  • Detection involves monitoring JWT IDs and unusual login patterns.
